utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll let folks know right away and ask who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sorting donated tools and matching them to repair jobs sounds like a good place for me to help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane. Let’s start with the loose cabinet hinge in the hall, then I’ll hand you the tape and we can check the screws after that.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll take care of the cabinet hinge first, then we can sort the tape and screws.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds perfect, Rosa. I can help sort the donated tools and match them with the right repair jobs.

utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Rey — start with the tools on the left table, and I’ll bring Sam over so we can match them to the right repair jobs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll get started on the left table and keep an eye out for Sam.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane—it's still being lined up, and I’m waiting on Faye’s plan and drop-off time. Once that’s set, I’ll be there on time and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli — I’m still lining up the school schedule, and I’ll send the plan and drop-off time as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye—just send the plan and drop-off time when it’s ready, and I’ll be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus — that works for me. Just let me know the time, and I’ll be there after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Noah — just let me know what else you need, and I’ll bring the gloves and hammer.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: A few things still need attention, but we’ve got a good start—mostly sorting tools, checking the busted lights, and lining up a couple more hands.

utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still on, then? Just making sure I’m tracking the repair drive right.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, it’s still on — we’re just tightening up the last few pieces. Mostly tools, the lights, and getting a couple more hands together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll bring the drill and screws, and I’ll check back if I can help with anything else.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks, Nell — I’ll stick with the drill and screws, and I’ll check in if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a drill, hammer, screwdrivers, and a wrench set, and I’m free this Saturday morning. Just let me know what to bring!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — could you remind me which repair tasks need attention first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We should start with the loose hinges, any leaky fixtures, and the wobbly shelves first. I can bring the drill, screwdrivers, and wrench set Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that would really help. Once you send it, I can check for any gaps or overlaps.

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Opal — I’ve got the first one coming your way soon, and I’ll keep sending any new drop-off spots as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll keep things moving and send you the repair drive details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rosa — I appreciate it. Just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Sam — I’ll keep you posted and send the repair drive details as soon as they’re ready.

utterances.text: Mina: So it’s the old alley lamps and the squeaky gate, right? Want me to help make a quick list?

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You bet—I’ll bring the sturdy gloves and help sort the donated tools when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — just let me know if anything else comes up before then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can bring screws, tape, and a basic screwdriver. I’ll swing by a little late, but I’ve got it covered.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Dane — that covers the list. Just swing by whenever you can; we’ll save a spot for you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Glad to hear it — I can help carry stuff over if that’d make things easier.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, that’d help a lot. I’ll bring the duct tape and screws over, and I’ll look for that box cutter too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good—I’ll be there to help carry things over. Let me know if you spot anything else you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’ll be ready when you send the spot.

utterances.text: Kira: So it’s definitely happening, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — so it’s really on then? Just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll check back later and let you know what’s still missing. So far it’s looking good, but I’ll keep an eye out for anything they still need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate you keeping an eye on it — I’m glad it’s going well so far.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No problem at all — I’ll stop by later and see what gaps are left, then I’ll let you know. Hopefully we only need a few more bits and pieces.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I hear any updates while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help sort the donated tools and make a quick list. I should keep to light lifting today, though.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli. Can you sort the donated tools and jot down what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — that would really help. If you can check on pickup and I can sort the timing, I’ll feel a lot less worried.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll ask around about pickup and check my notes on the donations. Then we can line up the timing together.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring tape and check the signup table setup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ll bring gloves and a hammer, and I can help with setup too if you need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s perfect, thanks. If you can also bring a basic screwdriver, we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can bring a basic screwdriver too.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
